comments.author: doublex
comments.body:
Dear Nithin,

Thanks for the fix. Unfortunately, I’m still seeing the issue in another case.
Here’s another example where it fails (german):  [timestamperror.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24879882/timestamperror.zip)

Kind regards,


````python
from nemo.collections.asr.models import EncDecMultiTaskModel
model = EncDecMultiTaskModel.from_pretrained("nvidia/canary-1b-v2")

import librosa
audio, sr = librosa.load('timestamperror.wav', sr=16000)

hypotheses = model.transcribe(
    audio=audio,
    source_lang='de', target_lang='de', timestamps=True,
    batch_size=1,
    return_hypotheses=True,
)
print(hypotheses)
assert hypotheses[0].timestamp['word']
````

comments.author: nithinraok
comments.body: Thanks @doublex, This is a different issue where the model hallucinates. We use another CTC model inside Canary for timestamp prediction, and in scenarios where the CTC predictions differ significantly from the Canary predictions, we do not output timestamps.
